tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba mchog rnams kun gyi dngos/ /lhan skyes dga' chen he ru ka /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ / mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis/ /rigs lnga'i lha tshogs byon par gyur/ /bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing khrus byas pas/ dbang bzhi thob/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlab te/ oṃ ā hūṃ zhes myang*/ oṃ ā mṛ ta bā tsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ rang gi sems nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes spros pa mtha' dag gis dben pa'o/ / zhes mnyam par bzhag / rang skad cig gi 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa lan gsum thugs ka'i hūṃ las raṃ 'og phyogs su chad/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūṃ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis/ sa gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur/ hūṃ las hūṃ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par bltams pa/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu bzhu ste rwa gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing*/ phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum/ skyabs yul de rnams bdag gi mdun du byon te/

'od zer rang gi lus la phog pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang skyabs yul dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na mo me hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gnyis kyis nang mchod dang gsang mchod phul/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams gnyis su med cing dmigs su med pa'o/ / zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshogs zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do/ /oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ / zhes mnyam par bzhag / stong pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las ri rgyal lhun po shar shel/ byang ser/ nub pad+ma rā ga /lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi dang ldan zhing lcog brgyad kyis brgyan pa gru bzhi pa ste/ 'byung bzh-i ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /de'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa dang*/

pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du rang sems zla ba dmar skya la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ rtse mo rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang*/ ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang ska rags dang mchod phyir sogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/

thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du brngo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga/byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod phrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing*/ mi ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa thod pas kha brgyan pa dang bcas pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ lā ma la don yod grub pa/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ cung zad rgyas pa la spro na lha dbang bskur ba'i skabs 'dir/

byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka 'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang yod pa ltar spro na bya'o/ de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len la de lta bu gtso bor mi mdzad do/ /des na bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur*/ oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang*/ gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ gzhir gnas kyi dam rdzas dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/ lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu te thim/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te bdud rtsi myangs pas/ lha thams cad bde bas mnyes par bsam/ bar 'dir rdzogs rim rtsa 'khor lo bzhi pa'i gtum mo dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ste yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+bha raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ṇī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khan+ṭa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags so/ /ces ci nus su bzla/ gtor chog dang 'brel ba yin na skabs 'dir gtor ma gtong ba yin na'ang*/

sgrub thabs tsam sgom pa la/ skabs 'dir gtor ma nges par dgos pa ma yin pas/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu byas te/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /de yang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ bdag nyid kyi bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu/ lha mo bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi rang la thim/ yum yang yab kyi thugs kar thim/ dpal he ru ka yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag / 'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang he ru ka'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob te/ /'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod gang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa/ /byang chub rdo rjes sngags pa yi/ /spyod pa de gnyis bdag spyod shog / ces dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na legs par bshams te/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā ba sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me'i steng du/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las ka pā la/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ na go ku da ha las mi/ ba glang*/ khyi rta glang chen te sha lnga/ dbus dang mtshams bzhir mu bi ra shu ma las/ chu sman/ rdul/ khu ba/ klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga'i thad kyi steng rnams su/ hūṃ oṃ traṃ hriḥ.a ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la zla ba la oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba/ bdud rtsis rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāṃ ga dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge bco lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum du byas/

kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i rtse mor hūṃ/ /de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bkug nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la thim/ zla ba yi ge gsum kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang bcas thod pa'i nang du lhung*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gis dkrugs pas thams can zhu ste/ dam rdzas dang gnyis su med par gyur pas/ gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /ha ho hriḥ lan mang du brjod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ / rang gi mdun du 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ rig drug gi sems can thams cad/ he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pas phyogs thams cad nas bskor ba grub par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pas phaiṃ/ /oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes 'khor lo'i rnam par byon pa rnams dam tshig 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mgron skyed pa'o/ / lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍī ki nī i daṃ ba laṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge bdun pa dang*/ bai ro tsa na dang*/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan lngas 'bul he ye shes lha la mchod pa'o/ / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ud man+ta/ a pa smar/ nā ka/ ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ bā liṃ/ grih+nan tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭhaṃ bhuñdza tha pi ba thā/ dzigh+ra thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shud+dha/ sa ha yi ka bhan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyi dur khrod na gnas pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i gsang sngags kyis bstod/

bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas/ khyed la mchod cing bstod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ / las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ / dngos grub kun gyis staungs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ / 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas 'phrin las gzhol lo/ / gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol/ / zhes pa bzod par gsol lo/ / oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /

slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes mgron gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med pa/ / sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral pa rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa/ /bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog / ces shis pa brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ / zhes dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgongs don gang*/ /blo dman rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /ngag 'don cung zad bsdebs pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro kun grol gyur cig/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ / oṃ swā sti/ dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi par khang du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod chen/ dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma'i cho ga /sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid yig /de'i gegs sel 'khrul 'khor/ dus 'khor chos 'byung*/ bde mchog bstod chen/ dges pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga / gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal/ yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi sgrub dkyil/ tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi cho ga /'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag /bsngo ba yas gtam sogs/ par brkos kyi 'du byed/ mdo smad brag sna pa gzhon nu/ rdo rje lhun grub/ sa skya skyab pa/

lcags thang pa bstan pa yar 'phel bzhi'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ rta lo nas bya lo hor zla lnga pa yin la/ bslab cing brkos mthar phyin pa dang*/ gong gi chos tshan so so brkos pa'i dge bas skye ba 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i bstan pa la phan cing bya ba byed nus pa gcig tu skye bar gyur cig/ // maṅgalaṃ// bdag gis skye ba 'di nas 'phos ma thag /sngags kyi zhing der ma 'gag bzhugs pa'i drung*/ /thugs sras mchog gi thu bor skyes nas kyang*/ /tshe gcig gsang chen lam bzang mthar phyin shog /ma tis smras/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 184 -- PAGE 185 -- PAGE 176 -
